title: 第23章 空间迷雾梦境固化第24章 副本迷梦生存任务
slug: 虚实梦境之主从死后开始
content_zh:
在同化了一位门卫之后，孟天又看向了另外一位，在听到梦境主人名字之后，明显放松了不少的门卫。
“美女，你好！”
孟天再次伸出手。
“你好！”
美女门卫本能的伸手。
然后，孟天力量倾注，迅速的将其同化。
随着两个门卫的同化完成，那弥漫天地的压制排斥力量，开始迅速的降低。
虽然没有彻底的消散，但也只是淡淡的将其笼罩。
只要孟天不做什么太过出格的事情，那股力量都不会将他如何。
不过…
不做那是不可能的。
孟天心中动念，死亡空间的力量，瞬间沿着与他之间的联系，降临到了这方梦境空间，以他站立之处为中心，迅速的向着周围侵蚀扩散。
而随着死亡空间的力量，开始侵蚀这方梦境空间。
那股弥漫周围的梦境之力，开始再一次的一点点增强，压制、排斥他的力量。
不过，因为一开始的力量薄弱，使得孟天对于这方梦境空间，轻松完成了最初的侵蚀同化，以他站立之处方圆一米，成了他的独立领域。
哪怕梦境力量随后得到了增强，也已经难以对他造成威胁了。
当然了，他不能离开所站立的这一处米许方圆的独立领域。
不过对于他来说，倒也不是什么太大的问题。
他只要慢慢的接引死亡空间的力量，一点点的侵蚀同化这方梦境空间就行了。
孟天操控着力量扩散，一点点的同化梦境空间，扩张着自己的领域。

虽然阻力越来越大，但好在能够进行。
直到…
在到达别墅大门的时候，阻力瞬间几何倍数的增加，甚至大门处都是泛起了道道空间涟漪。
别墅之内的莺莺燕燕，纷纷的转过头来，凶狠的盯着孟天，随时准备冲向门口，将他撕成粉碎。
别墅三楼，一道胖胖的身影来到阳台，目光警惕的看向他。
一队美女保镖，自别墅之内快速的奔来，人人手持警棍冲向孟天。
“外来者，离开这里！”
看着别墅之中的莺莺燕燕，还有大门前列成一排，手持警棍，警惕看着他的美女保镖。
以及别墅三楼的阳台，那一个熟悉的胖子身影，孟天脸上露出一抹若有所思之色。
他也许知道，为什么这次进入梦境空间，会引来梦境空间的排斥了。
那个熟悉的身影，梦境主人楚泽涛，正是他先前进入过的，那一个春梦的梦境主人。
也许是因为他的闯入，恐吓乃至强行掠夺梦境能量的原因，使得梦境主人在潜意识之中，开始对自己的梦境进行守护，抵御外敌。
特别是孟天这个曾经的入侵者，感应到他的力量气息，这种防护肯定还会再增几分。
所以，孟天这一次进入梦境，并没有出现在梦境主人的附近，而是出现在了别墅之外，不但远离了梦境主人，还被别墅阻拦在外。
并且出现了门卫，以及别墅保镖。
嗯，虽然维持了楚泽涛的一贯作风，依旧全是美女。
但是，并不影响保镖门卫的能力。
他们乃是梦境人物，是男是女完全没有什么影响。
若不是孟天有着同化的能力，还真要被其阻挡在外了呢。
不过，看着两米外的大门处，那一排美女保镖，孟天还是收回了向着别墅侵蚀的力量。

他没有必要强行硬闯。
随着力量的收回，那些美女保镖的神色，明显放松了些许。
content_en:
After assimilating one guard, Meng Tian looked at another guard who clearly relaxed a lot after hearing the name of the owner of the dream.
"Hello, beauty!"
Meng Tian extended his hand again.
"Hello!"
The beautiful guard instinctively stretched out her hand.
Then, Meng Tian poured out his power and quickly assimilated it.
As the assimilation of the two guards was completed, the suppressive and repulsive power that permeated the world began to decrease rapidly.
Although it did not completely dissipate, it only enveloped it lightly.
As long as Meng Tian doesn't do anything too outrageous, that force won't do anything to him.
But…
It's impossible not to do that.
Meng Tian thought in his heart, and the power of the death space instantly descended into this dream space along the connection with him. Centered on where he stood, it quickly eroded and spread to the surroundings.
And with the power of the dead space, it began to erode this dream space.
The power of the dream that permeated the surroundings began to strengthen little by little again, suppressing and repelling his power.
However, due to his weak strength at the beginning, Meng Tian easily completed the initial erosion and assimilation of this dream space, and the one-meter radius where he stood became his independent domain.
Even if the power of the dream was subsequently enhanced, it would no longer pose a threat to him.
Of course, he could not leave the independent area of ​​​​Mishu where he was standing.
But for him, it's not a big problem.
All he needs to do is slowly draw in the power of the dead space and erode and assimilate this dream space bit by bit.
Meng Tian controlled the spread of power, assimilating the dream space bit by bit, expanding his domain.
Although the resistance is getting bigger and bigger, fortunately it can be carried out.
Until…
When arriving at the gate of the villa, the resistance instantly increased exponentially, and even space ripples appeared at the gate.
The Yingying Yanyan in the villa turned their heads one after another, staring fiercely at Meng Tian, ​​ready to rush to the door at any time and tear him into pieces.
On the third floor of the villa, a fat figure came to the balcony and looked at him warily.
A group of beautiful bodyguards came quickly from the villa, each holding a baton and rushing towards Meng Tian.
"Outsiders, get out of here!"
He looked at the Yingying Yanyan in the villa, and the beautiful bodyguards lined up in front of the gate, holding batons and watching him warily.
As well as the familiar figure of the fat man on the balcony on the third floor of the villa, a thoughtful look appeared on Meng Tian's face.
He may know why entering the dream space this time will attract the rejection of the dream space.
That familiar figure, the dream master Chu Zetao, was exactly the dream master of the spring dream he had entered before.
Perhaps because of his intrusion, intimidation and even forcible plunder of dream energy, the dream owner subconsciously began to protect his dream and resist foreign enemies.
Especially since Meng Tian, ​​a former intruder, senses his aura of power, this protection will definitely increase a bit more.
Therefore, when Meng Tian entered the dream this time, he did not appear near the dream owner, but appeared outside the villa. Not only was he far away from the dream owner, but he was also blocked by the villa.
And there were doormen and villa bodyguards.
Well, although they maintained Chu Zetao's usual style, they were still all beauties.
However, this does not affect the ability of the bodyguards and doormen.
They are dream characters, and whether they are male or female has no effect at all.
If Meng Tian hadn't had the ability to assimilate, he would have been blocked by him.
However, looking at the row of beautiful bodyguards at the gate two meters away, Meng Tian still withdrew his power to erode towards the villa.
There was no need for him to force his way through.
As their strength was restored, the expressions of the beautiful bodyguards became visibly relaxed.
